scope: Isolated database, checked-in table definitions and sales function. No live transactions; concurrency and full hosted role integration are not tested.
checks: Gram sale deducts kilogram stock and saves correct total/header/line.
Insufficient stock rejects sale without partial stock/header/line writes.
Weight/volume mismatch and fractional or mismatched discrete units are denied.
Zero and negative quantities are denied.
Pounds convert to grams for pricing and kilograms for stock deduction.
Member role cannot record counter sales.
Administrator merchandise sale saves total and deducts whole items.
